Name: Audrey - New Custom NPC
Author: TL0TD
Description:
[url=https://tlotd.net/][img]https://tlotd.net/assets/projects/made_by_tlotd.png[/img][/url] [url=https://isla-nublar.com/][img]https://tlotd.net/assets/projects/made_by_isla_nublar.png[/img][/url]
In the backwoods above the old farm lies a mountain cottage. Living inside is the kind and curious Audrey. She and her grandmother arrived in Pelican Town when she was just a little girl. After her grandmothe's death Willy took on the mantle of raising her, he took her fishing and told her stories about the sea.

She's marriageable with her own custom cottage, which can be moved either above the path to the mountains or above the road to the bus stop in the config. A custom spouse room, winter sprites, event dialouges & a (for now limited) schedule.

[b]Installation:
[/b]- Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher
- Place the folder inside the .zip file in your "\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Requires:[/b]
- [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ [/color]

[b]Recommends:[/b]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]

[b]Notes:
[/b]- Birthday: Spring 9
- Loves: Cactus Fruit, Coconut, Complete Breakfast, Duck Feather, Fish Taco, Golden Pearl, Golden Pumpkin, Hazelnut, Maple Bar, Maple Syrup, Pancakes, Pearl, Piña Colada, Roasted Hazelnuts, Sunflower, Tortilla.
